tools.name: route4me_get_account
tools.description: Get the signed-in Route4Me member: name, role, time zone and account status. A good first call to check the connection. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/team/users/me.

tools.name: route4me_list_users
tools.description: List team members (sub-users), optionally only drivers, and filter by a search query. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/team/users.

tools.name: route4me_list_vehicles
tools.description: List fleet vehicles, with an optional search text and an operational filter. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/vehicles.

tools.name: route4me_get_vehicle
tools.description: Get one vehicle by id, with its profile and current state. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/vehicles/{id}.

tools.name: route4me_get_vehicle_track
tools.description: Get the recorded GPS track of one vehicle between two times (Unix seconds). vehicle_id is the vehicle's hex id from route4me_list_vehicles. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/vehicles/{id}/track.

tools.name: route4me_list_routes
tools.description: List routes with pagination, sorting, grouping and filters. Pass filters as the API expects them (object). Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/routes/list.

tools.name: route4me_get_route
tools.description: Get one route by id, with its stops and status. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/routes/{route_id}.

tools.name: route4me_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with pagination, sorting, a search text and filters (day, status, group). Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/orders/list.

tools.name: route4me_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with filters, sorting and pagination. Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/customers/list.

tools.name: route4me_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: route4me_list_facilities
tools.description: List facilities (depots, warehouses) with a search text and pagination. Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/facilities.

tools.name: route4me_list_addresses
tools.description: Search the address book with a text query, field selection, filters and paging. Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/address-book/addresses/index/all.

tools.name: route4me_list_groups
tools.description: List the address book groups (sets of addresses). Route4Me API: GET /api/v5.0/address-book/groups.

tools.name: route4me_geocode_address
tools.description: Turn one street address into coordinates. Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/geocoding/forward.

tools.name: route4me_list_optimizations
tools.description: List route optimizations, or get one by optimization_problem_id, with state and date filters. Route4Me API: GET /api.v4/optimization_problem.php.

tools.name: route4me_create_optimization
tools.description: Create and run a route optimization for a list of addresses (lat/lng or address text) with routing parameters. It stores the optimization and its routes in the account. Route4Me API: POST /api.v4/optimization_problem.php.

tools.name: route4me_rerun_optimization
tools.description: Re-optimize an existing optimization after changing its routing parameters or stops. It replaces the stored routes of that optimization. Route4Me API: PUT /api.v4/optimization_problem.php.

tools.name: route4me_create_order
tools.description: Create one order (a delivery or service stop) with its address, time window and contact fields. Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/orders.

tools.name: route4me_update_order
tools.description: Update one order. order_id and order_uuid identify it (from route4me_list_orders); the other fields change only when passed. Route4Me API: PUT /api/v5.0/orders/update.

tools.name: route4me_create_address
tools.description: Add one address to the address book with its coordinates and optional contact and time-window fields. Route4Me API: POST /api/v5.0/address-book/addresses.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: route4me_list_routes, route4me_list_orders, route4me_list_customers, route4me_list_addresses, route4me_create_optimization · Private data: route4me_create_order, route4me_create_address · Public sink: route4me_list_routes, route4me_list_orders, route4me_list_customers, route4me_list_addresses, route4me_geocode_address, route4me_create_optimization, route4me_create_order, route4me_create_address · Destructive: route4me_create_optimization.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: route4me_list_routes, route4me_list_orders, route4me_list_customers, route4me_list_addresses, route4me_create_optimization · Private data: route4me_create_order, route4me_create_address · Public sink: route4me_list_routes, route4me_list_orders, route4me_list_customers, route4me_list_addresses, route4me_geocode_address, route4me_create_optimization, route4me_create_order, route4me_create_address · Destructive: route4me_create_optimization

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
